title: Ports, Protocols, and Services Management (PPSM) Schema
description: Schema for defining and generating Ports, Protocols, and Services Management content as CSV data.

$schema.description: The schema to verify this document against.

$id.description: A unique identifier for the schema.

$comment.description: Comments from schema authors to readers or maintainers of the schema.

title.description: The title of the artifact when generated.

artifactType.description: The type of the artifact to be generated.

outputType.description: The output type of the artifact when generated.

order.description: The order of data properties when generated.

Letter.description: The PPSM letter or identifier associated with the traffic flow.

Flow Direction.description: The direction of the traffic flow, such as inbound, outbound, or both.

Port.description: The port, port range, and protocol for the traffic flow.

Function.description: The function enabled by the listed port, protocol, and service.

Service.description: The service or system communication supported by the traffic flow.

data.description: Data to use for artifact generation.
